subject: general
question: A, B and C begin together to move around a circular stadium and they completed their revolution in 42 s, 63 s and 84 s respectively, After how much time will they come together at the starting point?
solution:
**Given:**

A, B and C begin together to move around a circular stadium and they completed their revolution in 42 s, 63 s and 84 s respectively

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

They will meet together at starting point after,

LCM of (42, 63, 84) seconds.

⇒ 84 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 7

⇒ 42 = 2 × 3 × 7

⇒ 63 = 3 × 3 × 7

LCM = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 7 = 252 seconds

**∴ They will meet together at starting point after 252 sec.**
